sourceDecision: Retain production. The public MetadataTable wrapper opening is a div with only className="overflow-x-auto rounded-lg border border-zinc-800"; it declares no tabIndex, role, aria-label or aria-labelledby. The inner table declares aria-label={label} and className="w-full text-sm"; label is a string prop. Public mount/path callers retain literal KV mounts and KV paths labels. These literal declarations do not establish keyboard reachability, browser focus defaults, actual overflow/scrolling, accessible-tree naming or assistive-technology conformance. Inspected saved metadata harnesses omit the real table and substitute either a props-only metadata-table stub or a string placeholder. Their saved role/aria-live assertions apply to the stub props, not the actual wrapper. No concrete supported correction compatible with all frozen expectations was established.
